gloss: quick work; nimble technique; feat of speed

definitions.gloss: quick work; nimble technique; feat of speed
definitions.explanation: An action performed with impressive speed and skill. Used to describe someone completing a task remarkably fast, a quick sleight-of-hand trick, or a rapid technique in martial arts or sports.

examples.japanese: さすがプロの{早技|はやわざ}だ。
examples.english: That's impressive quick work — a true professional.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{早技|はやわざ}で{料理|りょうり}を{三品|さんぴん}{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: He whipped up three dishes with impressive speed.

examples.japanese: {手品師|てじなし}の{早技|はやわざ}に{観客|かんきゃく}は{目|め}を{見張|みは}った。
examples.english: The audience was amazed by the magician's sleight of hand.

notes:
Combines {早|はや} (fast, quick) and {技|わざ} (technique, skill). Also written as {早業|はやわざ} with the same meaning. Carries a tone of admiration — the speed is not just fast but skillful.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早技|はやわざ}で{片付|かたづ}ける: to finish something off quickly
- {早技|はやわざ}を{見|み}せる: to show off quick work
- さすがの{早技|はやわざ}: impressive quick work (as expected)
- {見事|みごと}な{早技|はやわざ}: splendid quick technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荒技|あらわざ}: rough technique — impressive but forceful, not necessarily fast
- {離れ技|はなれわざ}: remarkable feat — emphasizes the difficulty rather than speed
- {手際|てぎわ}がいい: deft, efficient — describes skillful handling of work, overlapping in meaning
